faq.q: How much does Moseley Collins Law, APLC charge?
faq.a: Moseley Collins Law, APLC publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Moseley Collins Law, APLC offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Moseley Collins Law, APLC publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Moseley Collins Law, APLC have offices?
faq.a: Moseley Collins Law, APLC publishes three offices, in Sacramento, Seattle and San Diego. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Moseley Collins Law, APLC?
